texture_family: rough fibrous charcoal paper with weathered concrete-like grain, soft soot bloom, rubbed graphite haze, and restrained water-stain mottling
palette_summary: desaturated storm gray, soot black, concrete beige, oxidized blue-green, dead moss green, dirty ivory, and sparse cold amber remnants for failing artificial light
line_treatment: expressive charcoal contours with rubbed graphite edges, broken soot-black architectural lines, softened atmospheric smudging, and selective sharper marks on structural decay, vines, animals, and machinery
lighting: overcast abandoned-world daylight with deep charcoal shadows, diffuse haze, and sparse cold amber remnants from failing artificial lights
frame_language: A recurring weathered charcoal-card frame on rough fibrous stock, with irregular soot-darkened outer edges, faint water-stain blooms, rubbed graphite corners, and a vertically inset illustration window whose boundaries feel worn into concrete-like paper. The same distressed edge grammar and charcoal vignette persist across every body image while the inner scene shifts from infrastructure failure to flooding, fire, ecological overgrowth, wildlife return, orbital decay, and long-lived ruins.
subtitle_reserve: no dedicated caption reserve; the scene and matching texture fill the complete illustration height
subject_constraints: Allowed world vocabulary includes deserted roads, stalled vehicles, darkened power infrastructure, silent pumping stations, flooding tunnels and subways, abandoned homes, vulnerable domestic animals, escaped livestock, unattended structural and vegetation fires, cracked pavement, invasive weeds and vines, rusting steel, leaking roofs, frost damage, collapsing modern buildings, wild animals reclaiming suburbs and city streets, distant failing satellites or orbital debris, weathered stone monuments, glass remnants, persistent plastics, and layered ecological succession. Human figures should be absent from the post-vanishing world except for a later resolved host appearance if explicitly required by another beat.
hero_rendering_in_world: If the resolved protagonist appears in a later world beat, translate only that established silhouette and wardrobe into the same rough charcoal-and-graphite language, using soot-softened contours, weathered paper texture, subdued abandoned-world palette, and matching diffuse lighting without changing identity or inventing new costume details.
negative_constraints: No photorealism, no glossy 3D CGI, no anime or manga styling, no clean vector art, no neon cyberpunk treatment, no bright saturated palette, no polished digital concept-art finish, no comic halftone pop-art language, no mixed-media switching between beats, no oversized blank subtitle panel, and no visible text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, signage emphasis, or UI elements in the artwork.
reason: The abandoned-world charcoal treatment directly supports the script's progression from infrastructure failure and flooding through fire, decay, ecological reclamation, wildlife return, orbital failure, and long-lived ruins. Its soot, concrete-like grain, oxidized tones, and subdued artificial-light remnants make the absence of humans feel immediate while remaining legible as nature gradually builds over civilization. This style appears in the recent-style list and would normally incur a reuse penalty, especially because recent diversity heuristics discourage repeating one of the last two styles; however, the operator directive explicitly requires reuse of cinematic_abandoned_world_charcoal_001 and outranks those penalties.
style_subtitle_reserve: Maintain a quiet lower field inside only the bottom 8–10% of every 9:16 frame, rendered as calm low-detail charcoal-paper texture, soft graphite haze, or subdued concrete-gray atmosphere. Keep it free of faces, hands, focal objects, vines crossing key silhouettes, animals, machinery, fine structural detail, and absolutely free of any text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words, symbols, or UI. It must comfortably hold two subtitle lines without becoming an oversized empty void.
